messages:
Maya Ortiz: FYI inbound POC from NorthStar. Goal: swap their runtime from NorthStar API -> Redwood for a week-long pilot. Procurement raised three live items: API parity, surge pricing during demo, and security questionnaire. Can eng/security triage?
Diego Alvarez: I'll take API parity. Do they use multi-turn streaming + response metadata?
Maya Ortiz: Yes streaming enabled for chat UI; they also rely on `candidates[]` in responses for re-ranking.
Renee Park: Quick note on parity work: we usually need to emulate field names and stable message ids. Also token accounting differs — they expect prompt/completion split.
Ibrahim Khan: For the streaming part we can proxy chunked events. Important: NorthStar returns chunks with `event: partial_delta` and final `event: done`. Our runtime uses chunk `type` attributes. Proxy will translate event names.
Nora Fields: Security team received their vendor security pack (42 items). Immediate asks: evidence of SOC2, encryption key control, SAML SSO support, and data residency. They also want a signed subprocessor appendix.
sec-bot: [auto] Questionnaire link uploaded to drive: https://redwood-internal/sec/northstar-poc-2026
Diego Alvarez: Example of their request (current):
```
POST https://api.northstar.ai/v1/complete
Authorization: Bearer NS-KEY
Body: {"model":"northstar-chat-xl","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize quarterly ops"}],"stream":true}
```
Diego Alvarez: Our equivalent is:
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.stream
Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD-KEY
Body: {"model":"redwood-chat-13b","input":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize quarterly ops"}],"stream":true}
```
Diego Alvarez: Proxy plan: accept NS payload, map `model` -> redwood model alias, translate `messages`->`input`, and emit events `partial_delta` / `done` to match NorthStar semantics. Also insert `usage.prompt_tokens` and `usage.completion_tokens` in final JSON.
Renee Park: On candidates: NorthStar returns `candidates: [{id, text, score}]`. We return `outputs[]` without score. We'll add a mapping layer to populate `candidates` using output text + normalize score from `metrics.logits_norm` when available. If not, return null score.
Ibrahim Khan: Reranker flow note: they do an LRO call to /v1/rerank with `candidate_ids` referencing prior response ids. We'll need to preserve those ids in the proxy or include a mapping table so the rerank call can resolve.
Nora Fields: For KMS: they insist on customer-managed keys. Hosted Redwood supports envelope encryption with customer KMS for private deployments; for hosted SaaS we can offer VPC + BringYourOwnKey in a limited pilot. I'll draft a KMS statement for the questionnaire.
Maya Ortiz: Procurement question: "If traffic spikes 2x during the demo, will we throttle or bill overage?"
Ibrahim Khan: For POC, recommend offering a temporary burst with an explicit cap and notify finance. We can set a soft limit that logs alerts at 1.2x and a hard cap at 3x.
Renee Park: Also note small semantic diffs: role names `assistant` vs `bot`, and presence of `metadata.session_id`. We'll document transformations so their frontend doesn't break.
Nora Fields: They've asked about SOC2 cert date + last penetration test. I'll attach cert PDF and a short PT summary. Also they want the subprocessor list — legal has the current list, will attach.
Maya Ortiz: Timeline: customer exec demo in 9 business days. Can we commit to a minimal parity run (10 canonical prompts + rerank cases) and security answers by EOD +4?
Diego Alvarez: Parity run: I'll stand up proxy on staging and run side-by-side for the 10 prompts. ETA EOD +3.
Renee Park: I'll prepare the canonical prompt set with edge cases (HTML, code blocks, red-team prompt). ETA EOD +1.
Nora Fields: Security pack first draft to procurement by EOD +2.
Ibrahim Khan: I'll implement id-preservation for candidates/rerank in the proxy. ETA EOD +3.
Maya Ortiz: Great. Action items consolidated: Diego parity + proxy (EOD+3), Renee prompt set (EOD+1), Nora sec answers + attachments (EOD+2), Ibrahim rerank id map (EOD+3), Maya to confirm demo window and invite demo attendees (today).
Maya Ortiz: Kickoff call scheduled 11am PT tomorrow. Please join if you're on action list.
Diego Alvarez: I'll be on the call.
Renee Park: same.
Nora Fields: I'll cover security Q&A.
Ibrahim Khan: I'll be there for infra questions.
Maya Ortiz: Thanks team. I'll keep updates here; please paste short status notes only. :rocket:
